# React Native Network Configuration & Stream Viewer Project

## Project Setup Checklist

- [x] Verify that the copilot-instructions.md file in the .github directory is created
- [x] Scaffold the Expo React Native Project
- [x] Customize the Project with SRS requirements
- [x] Install Required Extensions
- [x] Compile the Project
- [x] Create and Run Task
- [x] Launch the Project
- [x] Ensure Documentation is Complete

## Project Overview
This is a React Native Expo application for Network Configuration and Stream Viewer with:
- Camera configuration screen (FR-A1, FR-A2, FR-A3)
- HLS video streaming viewer (FR-C1, FR-C2, FR-C3, FR-C4)
- Critical alarm system (FR-Z1, FR-Z2)
- Secure credential storage
- Network discovery/LAN scanning

## Tech Stack
- React Native with Expo (Managed Workflow)
- TypeScript
- expo-av (Video/Audio playback)
- expo-secure-store (Encrypted storage)
- @react-navigation/native (Navigation)
- react-native-netinfo (Network state)
- @expo/vector-icons (Icons)
